description: A strict item can advance over empty p because a later symbol can read. The ready capture condition then evaluates a split with an empty delimiter, so reconstruction ends with a grammar error (engine §4, §7.4, §10).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a0 | c
%rule a0 (A [+T] B)
%rule c (A [+T r] B [+U])
%rule r ($x:p q) %conditions "Z" ∉ "Z".split($x.value)

%rule p ε | B
%rule q ε | X
%rule migration-fault ε | {_} %conditions "x" ∈ $.value.split($.value)
